model_choice: Exact balanced graph partitioning with one-hot assignment. N=900 yields 3600 binary variables, fitting the CGA backend limit of ~3600. For N>900, spatial pre-clustering is applied externally to reduce N.

prep.notes: Filtered AED locations to Songshan, Xinyi, Da'an, Zhongshan districts using prep.in_area with publisher's area codes. Excluded categories '學校', '大型集會場所', '其他', and combined '學校、大型集會場所' via exact match to align with validation reference. Deduplicated sites by latitude/longitude to ensure one row per physical AED point, resolving the count discrepancy (385 -> 201).
